entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
"We only criticise what the US does." Former US Assistant Secretary of State David Stilwell defends America's actions in Iran, discusses New Zealand's anti-nuclear stance, and explains what Washington now expects from allies like New Zealand. Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

Guyon Espiner sits down with this retired Air Force Brigadier General for a wide-ranging interview on US foreign policy, China, Iran and New Zealand's place in an increasingly unstable world.
